channel.title: North Bay Nugget - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Bay Nugget (nugget.ca)

item.title: Province announces over $300,000 to support public health in Nipissing
item.description: The government is directing the money to boost public health care across the region giving more access to regional residents

item.title: Four North Bay students win science competition with an uncrackable safe
item.description: Proud teacher James Ross says his four students winning Montreal physics competition, "Highlights the immense value of science education in North Bay."

item.title: Témiscaming Titans hire Thomas Laforge as new head coach
item.description: Who says you can't go home again? The Témiscaming Titans select former player Thomas Laforge as their new head coach

item.title: Powassan Voodoos roll over the French River Rapids scoring 12 times in blowout win
item.description: Powassan wins the season series with French River 8-0 and now trail third-place Timmins by three points with a game in hand

item.title: Charity volleyball tourney to benefit The Gathering Place returns in March
item.description: To date, participation in NPSC’s Charity Mixed Volleyball Tournament has helped raise over $7,600 in support of The Gathering Place’s mission.

item.title: Mattawa company donates $7,490 to local school breakfast programs
item.description: The funding is geared to supply nutritious breakfasts that they believe will support learning and well-being

item.title: North Bay Battalion pound the IceDogs 9-1 to pass them in the standings
item.description: Ethan Procyszyn had a five point night in North Bay's blowout win. Procyszyn was also a terrific plus five for the contest. The team also announced forward Shamar Moses has gone home for "personal reasons"

item.title: Mattawa council backs call for stronger support of steel and lumber sectors
item.description: In a show of regional solidarity, Mattawa council has endorsed a motion originally proposed by the Township of Nairn and Hyman, calling on the province of Ontario to bolster its support for key resource-based industries
